title: Signals, scoring, search và watchlists
scope_items: Database Migration 00010: Added strength_score, freshness_score, saturation_score, freshness_at, why_now, relevance_description, and embedding_vector to trends; created watchlists table with uq_watchlists_tenant_pk, ENABLE/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, tenant_isolation and admin_ops_scope policies; created watchlist_alert_logs for durable alert deduplication and cooldown tracking; narrow app_user/admin_user grants; reversible transactional down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (Source unavailable shows degraded data): Handled external platform disconnections and expired tokens (e.g. TikTok, Shopee, Google Trends). When disconnected, flags is_degraded=true, demotes confidence to CONFIDENCE_BAND_LOW, marks source_class=ESTIMATED, displays prominent degraded alert banner with reconnect CTA button on both Web and Mobile surfaces.

Acceptance Target 2 (Threshold alerts deduplicate): Watchlist threshold alerts deduplicate/debounce via deterministic fingerprints sha256(workspace_id:watchlist_id:trend_id:metric) and cooldown window (60 minutes). Implemented alert storm batching (EC-M02-004): when >5 simultaneous breaches occur, collapses into a single summary alert with count on Go backend, Web frontend, and Mobile client.

Acceptance Target 3 (Tenant-scoped semantic search): Vector and keyword search is strictly filtered by workspace_id = caller.WorkspaceID. Cross-tenant search attempts fail closed with zero data leakage across Go ConnectRPC backend, SvelteKit web client, and Flutter mobile client.
Module M04 Opportunity Conversion: Implemented ConvertToOpportunity RPC and client helpers linking source trend provenance into opportunity drafts with strict RBAC authorization.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_SourceUnavailableShowsDegradedData (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm degraded flag, low confidence, estimated source class, and reconnect guidance.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_ThresholdAlertsDeduplicateAndBatchStorms (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm fingerprint deduplication within cooldown window and storm summary batching for >5 breaches.
Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_TenantScopedSemanticSearch (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter tests confirm strict workspace isolation and keyword/semantic matching.
Migration 00010 Verified: TestLoadAndValidateCanonicalP004Migration and TestUpStatusDownTransactionalBehavior pass for all 10 migrations.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, Dart analyze/test.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check, vite build, 64 web tests + 6 admin tests), check_web_smoke.sh (SSR HTTP 200 on /kham-pha), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings + 74 tests) all pass.

Phase P2 local mock and degraded evaluation passed; live Shopee Open Platform affiliate trending API requires partner key.
Vector embedding column and hybrid cosine/token search contracts verified locally; production pgvector HNSW index executes in staging PostgreSQL.
